stem:
Researchers found seashell fossils, including those from mollusks and coral, in a rock formation high in the Rocky Mountains.

Which statement **BEST** explains why seashell fossils can be found on some mountains?

options.label: B
options.text: Rivers carried the rocks up the mountains.

options.label: C
options.text: The area was a sand dune that hardened as it was covered by water.

options.label: D
options.text: The mountains split to form canyons that contained organisms with shells.
